style_prefix: Ultra-realistic commercial photograph for a premium social-media ad, shot by a top food/product photographer on a full-frame camera. Natural, believable, not CGI, not illustration, no AI look.
rules: Strict rules: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signage, no watermarks, no brand names anywhere in the image. No recognizable faces (hands, backs, blurred or out-of-frame people are fine). Real textures and imperfections, accurate proportions, physically correct light and shadows, rich but natural color, sharp focus on the subject, clean composition with breathing room for text at the top.
consistency: Use the attached image as the visual reference: the SAME business, same place, same surfaces, props, color palette, lighting direction and color grade, as if shot in the same photo session. New angle and subject as described.
